name: 96740 · Kailua Kona, HI
findings: ZIP 96740 (Kailua Kona) has 184 nonprofit organizations. 74 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 53 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 96740 (Kailua Kona) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
50% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 96740 (Kailua Kona) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).
